name: ue-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for Unreal Engine development

plugins.name: ue-source-index
plugins.description: Greppable per-version index of Unreal Engine C++ source (types, UFUNCTIONs, UPROPERTYs, CVars, log categories, config keys, deprecations, module deps) plus anchored notes, so agents stop grepping the whole engine

plugins.name: unreal-agent-kit
plugins.description: Multi-agent workflow for Unreal Engine projects (tiered workers, a read-only reviewer, workstream briefs, delegation) plus uak, a CLI for a queued editor lock, detached runs, single-file compile checks, and build and test wrappers
